fields.description: Header word of the 8-byte-slot score table; zero in a fresh save.
fields.evidence: Slot 0 of the 37-slot table at save offset 0x00 (logical rev8 domain). Engine zero-initializes persistent state (FUN_08007690 clears DAT_03000094[0..12] and sets DAT_0300006d).
fields.name: save_header_counter

fields.description: Header validity sentinel; the only slot whose tag word differs from the per-entry tag 0x00202216.
fields.evidence: Save offset 0x04 holds 0xFFFFFFFE while slots 1-35 carry tag 0x00202216 at +4 (e.g. FUN_08013d28-adjacent table layout; structural).
fields.name: save_header_marker

fields.description: Packed gameplay options byte (56 in baseline); only the low 6 bits are consumed.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005d64 copies *(byte *)(DAT_08005f68 + 0x1c8) & 0x3f into scene state; FUN_08006d24 repeats the same masked read at DAT_08006fb8 + 0x1c8. Save offset 0x1C8 (logical rev8) holds 0x38 = 56, inside 0..63.
fields.name: options_flags

fields.description: Stage/mode selector consumed with a 10-bit mask and a 2-bit table index.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005d64 reads (*(ushort *)(DAT_08005f68 + 0x1cc) & 0x3ff) >> 4 and indexes a table with (*(byte *)(DAT_08005f68 + 0x1cc) & 0xc); FUN_08006d24 applies bit ops to *(byte *)(DAT_08006fb8 + 0x1cc). Save offset 0x1CC holds 0x0000.
fields.name: stage_selector

fields.description: Packed 32-bit config bitfield: low nibble, bits 4-9 and bits 10-16 are consumed as separate sub-fields.
fields.evidence: FUN_080061d4 loads puVar9 = (uint *)(DAT_080065d0 + 0x1d0) and merges *(byte *)puVar9 & 0xf (with an 8 < value branch), *(ushort *)puVar9 & 0x3f0 and *puVar9 & 0x1fc00 into scene state. Save offset 0x1D0 holds 0xFFFE0000.
fields.name: config_bitfield
